local function _1o0llIlI01oOlolo(t, k)
    local r = ""
    for i = 1, #t do
        r = r .. string.char(t[i] ~ k)
    end
    return r
end
local function _l1olOoO0l1000I0I(...)
    local t = {}
    for _, arr in ipairs({...}) do
        for i = 1, #arr do
            t[#t+1] = arr[i]
        end
    end
    return t
end
